dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Act like you're snapping a photo with the Kamera.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! So you mean we need to watch our timing when we take a picture? Hehe, Paimon's sure our Fungi friends can understand that now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, they reacted quickly, just as expected! At this rate, they'll be photography pros before we know it.
